summary: This Form 8-K filed by Definium Therapeutics, Inc. reports positive topline data from the Phase 3 Emerge study of DT120 ODT for major depressive disorder. The registrant issued a press release and posted a presentation on its website; no special-situation transaction such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change is disclosed. The filing is a routine disclosure of clinical trial results and does not constitute a special situation event.
